name: mem0
description: The Memory Layer for AI Agents - Drop-in memory infrastructure for AI agents and apps. Context that persists. Built for production.
readme: All benchmarks run on the same production-representative model stack. Single-pass retrieval (one call, no agentic loops) at a top_200 retrieval budget. Scores reflect Mem0's managed platform, which includes proprietary optimizations not available in the open-source SDK; open-source users should expect directionally similar gains but not identical numbers.
